fields.description: Empty until the reporting week is confirmed: a weekly review may then start on any day. Once set, every weekly review starts on this day.

fields.label: Reporting Week Ends On
fields.options:
Saturday
Sunday
Monday
Tuesday
Wednesday
Thursday
Friday
fields.description: The last working day of the week (owner: Saturday to Thursday). The days after it, to the next week's start, are days off: a close made on one still shows in the week, and a day off without a close is not listed as missing.

fields.label: Recovery Policy Approved
fields.description: Off until the owner approves a written policy checked by a lawyer or HR (deduction limits under the labour law and the contracts, how the employee is told and heard). While off, the owner cannot approve any recovery. The system never deducts from a salary either way.

fields.label: Policy Reference
fields.description: The approved policy: its title, date and who checked it.
